name: io.github.kenzotp/mcp-server-zuuna
description: MCP server for Zuuna — coding agents read and work your git-truth kanban board via the v1 API. 67 tools: boards, cards, comments, checklists, relations, attachments, time tracking, sprints, recurring cards, releases, deployments, webhooks and git-on-board linking.

environmentVariables.name: ZUUNA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API token from your Zuuna workspace. Grant only the scopes the agent needs (boards:read + cards:read is enough for a read-only observer).

environmentVariables.name: ZUUNA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Zuuna base URL. Defaults to https://app.zuuna.de.

environmentVariables.name: ZUUNA_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000.
